researcher_authored_brief: 研究者构造的用途转换任务：原来三名住户使用此住宅，其中一名成年子女已搬离；现有两位常住者需要一处专用办公桌面和坐席。可重新安排东北房间的用途，该房间原床不再是常住者必需床位，允许移出；无需保留来客过夜位置。保留该房间原书架实例，以及其余房间所有家具、睡眠位置、起居、家庭餐位、厨房和卫生间的通行与使用条件。房壳和开口不变，家具不缩放；不得通过移除其他必需功能来完成办公室。任务不规定采用何种家具操作或坐标。原住户原话、原项目操作过程不可得；50平方米的单层矩形、人数三变二、几何和资产均为研究假设，不是Michelet测绘或原历史初态。

geometry_assumptions.axes: Native centered XY; Z up, metres.
geometry_assumptions.source: Research flat transfer, not surveyed Michelet.

required_activities.requirement: Keep main sleeping furniture and access for two residents.
Preserve living and existing three dining seats; no deletion benefit.
Keep cold storage, cooker, sink, worktop and access.
Keep shower, basin, toilet and access; operation/privacy unknown.
Keep both initial bookshelf identities, including converted-room shelf.
Provide dedicated work surface and seat within the convertible room, with access.
Record loss of former bedroom capacity and unknown removed-bed destination.
Preserve complete state, actions, assets, reserved deleted ID and export.

uncertainties: Current tools set rigid poses; real carrying, disposal/storage of removed bed, fixture operation, installation and ergonomics remain unknown.
Original Michelet has vertically interleaved uses, stairs and sliding doors; this single-plane transfer does not reconstruct these features.
Windows/doorways are fixed apertures without operable leaves. Privacy, daylight quality and professional preference are unassessed.
A table used as a desk has no verified equipment, power, task comfort or prolonged-work acceptance.
No independent designer endorsement or original historical object identity.
